local cap = workspace.Phase1Map.capital
local cath
for _, m in ipairs(cap:GetDescendants()) do if m:IsA('Model') and m.Name == 'C16_cathedral' then cath = m end end
if not cath then return 'no cathedral' end
local ccf, csz = cath:GetBoundingBox()
local out = {string.format('cathedral centre (%.0f,%.1f,%.0f) size (%.1f,%.1f,%.1f)', ccf.X, ccf.Y, ccf.Z, csz.X, csz.Y, csz.Z)}
local inside = workspace.Phase1Map.capital_interior
local op = OverlapParams.new(); op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include; op.FilterDescendantsInstances = {cath}
for _, m in ipairs(inside:GetDescendants()) do
  if m:IsA('Model') and m:GetAttribute('PlanKey') then
    local cf, sz = m:GetBoundingBox()
    local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(cf, sz * 0.85, op)
    table.insert(out, string.format('%s at (%.0f,%.1f,%.0f) bottom=%.1f wallHits=%d', m.Name, cf.X, cf.Y, cf.Z, cf.Y - sz.Y/2, #hits))
  end
end
return table.concat(out, '\n', 1, math.min(#out, 14))
